record.field: Verify overall Height, Width, Depth against approved shop drawings within +/- 1mm tolerance. Measure opposing diagonals to confirm carcass is perfectly square.
Inspect all visible show-surfaces under 1000 lux lighting. Free from orange peel, runs, overspray, veneer bubbling, or stain blotching. Check gloss/sheen consistency.
Edge tape/banding must be firmly bonded with zero peeling, chipping, or excess glue line. Corner radiuses must be cleanly trimmed and smooth to touch.
Flat Floor Level & Wobble Stability Test
Place unit on a certified flat calibration floor. Apply corner-to-corner rocking pressure. Zero wobble permitted. Verify adjustable leveling glides turn smoothly.
Verify uniform 2mm to 3mm shadow gaps around all door fronts and drawer perimeter. Zero rubbing against framework. Drawer stops and catches fully functional.
Test door hinges and drawer runners through full travel cycles. Soft-close damping must engage smoothly without slamming or sticking. Handles tight and aligned.
Glass, Mirror, Stone & Metal Trim Inlays
Glass and mirrors scratch-free with polished safety edges. Marble/quartz tops chip-free with sealed joints. Brass/metal inlays flush and firmly seated.
Spot-check solid timber and MDF/plywood cores with calibrated pin moisture meter. Must read between 8% and 12% to prevent on-site warping or joint split.
Verify FR chemical application certificate, FR core substrate stamp, or fire-rated lacquer compliance where required by project contract specifications.
Protective Packaging, Corner Guards & Room Tagging
Fit heavy-duty foam corner guards, bubble wrap, and stretch film. Verify Floor, Room, and Piece Mark label is clearly visible. Loose assembly hardware pouch securely taped.
